description: This source file defines a generator for creating typed Kubernetes client code for individual resource types, including methods for CRUD operations, watching, patching, and applying configurations. It includes logic for handling different resource support features like namespacing, list, and apply support, and generates interface and struct implementations accordingly.

classes.name: genClientForType
classes.description: A generator struct responsible for producing client code for a specific resource type, including methods for filtering, naming, importing, and generating code snippets.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Determines if the given type matches the type to generate client code for.

methods.name: Namers
methods.description: Returns naming strategies for code generation.

methods.name: Imports
methods.description: Returns the list of external import lines needed for generated code.

methods.name: GenerateType
methods.description: Generates the client code for a specific resource type, including methods for CRUD, watch, patch, and apply operations.
